Name: Decay: Part 1
Overview:
Decay: Part 1 is a dark and atmospheric point and click adventure that places you in the role of a person somewhere between life and death. The game opens in a bathroom of a the players character who has just committed suicide, with the characters dead body hanging from a noose. Then the character wakes up from this 'death', not knowing what has seemingly brought him back from the dead to find a hand written note on a table outside of the bathroom that merely says ‘No friends, no family. Dead in bathroom.'

It is at this point the player takes control of the character and sets about finding out where the player is, where they are and what is going on. To do this, the player has to explore the immediate environment to uncover items that will give hints as to whats going on, either on their own or by combining the various pieces found to aid the investigation.
